title: Is WWIII Coming? When? 🔮 Psychic Predictions Events | Tittel Teatime 🫖
summary: A psychic channel relays spirit-guide predictions that WW3 is not here yet but will start in late 2028 through false flags, and ties the Iran war to an oil crisis.

assertions.quote: We are not on it. We're not in it. We're not on the edge of it quite yet, but we're almost there, friends.
late 2028 is where my feeling is that's when World War II really does kick off

verdicts.note: Forecasters put a direct great-power war by 2028 well under even odds, and a date read from spirit guides has no evidential basis.
Metaculus forecasters give a world war 22% over the whole 2019-2050 window, so a start in the single year 2028 is far less likely than not.
Clauset's base rate (about 43% per century for a WWII-sized war) gives under 1% for any single year, so naming 2028 has no statistical support.
Metaculus forecasters put World War III anywhere before 2050 at 22% (3.3k forecasters), which leaves any single year such as 2028 at around 1%.

assertions.quote: three flags that will fly ever so falsely likely in late 2028 between September and October that are meant to ignite three countries in conflict

verdicts.note: There is no evidence of any plan to stage false flags to start a world war; the claim rests on channelled visions.

assertions.quote: Spirit doesn't lie. I might misinterpret things, but spirits are they're always right.

verdicts.note: Tests of psychic forecasting find no accuracy above chance, and this source's own timing for the war has already shifted.

assertions.quote: has been in an oil crisis for quite some time, especially since the conflict with Iran kicked out
I see Poland somehow getting pulled into this. Bellarus. Belarus.

verdicts.note: After more than four years neither Poland nor Belarus has joined the fighting despite drone incursions, and forecasters put a direct Russia-NATO war in the next few years well under even odds.

assertions.quote: World War II will be the shortest of wars, says the spirits. Very short.

verdicts.note: The length of a war that has not happened, foretold by spirit guidance, cannot be checked.
CSIS warns a US-China war 'might not end after this initial phase but drag on for months or even years', since opening battles, even seemingly decisive ones, rarely end a war.
